outcome: Time to the return of the β-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) concentration to normal
Time to the return of menstruation
cohort: Patients with type II cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: Laparoscopy in combination with BUAO is associated with minimal trauma, rapid recovery, a short duration of surgery, low cost of hospitalization, and a low postoperative complication rate, representing a useful new surgical treatment for type II CSP.
